## `get_git_remote_url`

*Available in [Python](#get_git_remote_url-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Checks the URL for a git remote.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_git_remote_url(
        project_root=None,
        name='origin'
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_root` (`Path | None`) - The root directory of the project to get the remote URL for.
    - `name` (`str`) - The name of the remote to fetch the URL for (default: 'origin').

    <h4>Returns `str | None`</h4>

    str containing URL name or None
